functions.name: vm_log_vformat
functions.role: Logger format core (vendor-ish printf engine; %d/%u/%x/%X/%s/%c/%p with flags/width/precision).

functions.name: od_rx
functions.role: OD RX dispatch: decode 29-bit ID, match in-flight multi-frame slot or static endpoint, reassemble, invoke handler; kind==1 auto-replies

functions.name: led_ring_service
functions.role: handlebar LED-ring + button multi/long-press animation service (handlebar-specific, outside node layer)

functions.name: od_publish_core
functions.role: OD publish transport core: builds 29-bit CAN id from OD descriptor and fragments payloads >8 bytes (vendor transport layer).

functions.name: od_publish
functions.role: build 29-bit extended CAN ID from OD addr (node/index/subindex) and send payload via driver hook, splitting >8-byte payloads across frames with rolling sub-index

functions.name: button_fsm_tick
functions.role: Button state machine + multi/long-press timer expiry callback. Samples GPIO DIN, advances debounce states (idle/pressed/debounce/release), publishes the 3-byte {id,event,counter} OD frame every tick, arms long-press (1000ms) / multi-press (500ms) timers and logs press/release/multi/long events. Installed as a timer callback via DAT_00003240 (0x313d).

functions.name: can_send
functions.role: VENDOR: MCAN/MCP251XFD frame transmit used by led_ring_flush. Deferred.

functions.name: node_can_init
functions.role: program 4 RX acceptance filters/mailboxes (masks 0x4/0x1/0x8/0x2 000000) with node base id, register, enable RX

functions.name: led_ring_enable
functions.role: LED-ring enable/(re)init: 3-attempt loop programming SPI control regs, ring-specific IOMUX init (A/B), CAN object open, initial frame flush, then marks ring enabled. Logs 'led_ring_enable retries left %d'.

functions.name: od_apply
functions.role: image-update OD endpoint handler: sys_image validate->size->CRC(req)->allow_update chain, replies status on bus ('Image CRC failed %u vs %u')

functions.name: node_sm_dispatch
functions.role: pending-transaction service loop (10x0x5c slots: deadline/retry/callback); re-publishes due requests, reports -0x91 on expiry

functions.name: sys_image_erase_range
functions.role: erase the destination page range for a staged image; logs 'failed to erase page %d (err=%d)', records erased window

functions.name: led_ring_spi_init_b
functions.role: VENDOR: MSPM0 DriverLib SPI/IOMUX/clock bring-up for one LED ring (B routing). Deferred.

functions.name: led_ring_spi_init_a
functions.role: VENDOR: MSPM0 DriverLib SPI/IOMUX/clock bring-up for one LED ring (A routing). Deferred.

functions.name: sys_image_erase_pages
functions.role: erase a page-aligned run of flash in a sys_image slot and confirm each erase (asserts page alignment)

functions.name: serial_provision
functions.role: compare stored 96-byte serial vs default; on mismatch erase serial sector + rewrite serial record (0x18 words) + provisioning blob (0x16 words)

functions.name: sys_image_size
functions.role: parse staged image header (magic at DAT_0x4a1c, TLV magic at 0x4a20) and return declared image length

functions.name: can_status_poll
functions.role: CAN protocol-status poll: reads PSR, drains RX on bus-off, raises Error-Passive/Warning/Bus-Off DTCs, re-arms INIT for recovery

functions.name: sys_image_check_blank
functions.role: verify trailer word is 0xffffffff (blank) else erase staged region

functions.name: node_tick
functions.role: main-loop tick: apply pending self-update, publish heartbeat (status 0xa7) on period, service transactions + LED rings

functions.name: sys_image_allow_update
functions.role: stage/allow the update by writing the requested CRC into the image trailer and arming the apply

functions.name: can_drain_rx
functions.role: drain CAN RX FIFO and feed frames into od_rx dispatch

functions.name: node_main
functions.role: main: enter critical, board_init, serial_provision+log serial, node_init, node_can_init, NoRTOS super-loop (node_tick + WFI)

functions.name: led_ring_cmd_set_new_data
functions.role: CAN 'set led new data' command handler: payload [mask, index, R, G, B]; mask bit0=L bit1=R; logs 'D>L/R set led new data' and calls led_ring_set_pixel per selected ring.

functions.name: can_obj_open
functions.role: CAN object/filter (re)open used inside led_ring_enable (3-attempt).

functions.name: board_init
functions.role: peripheral bring-up (clocks/GPIO/CAN/flash subsystems)

functions.name: node_assert
functions.role: assertion/panic logger (file,line) used on page-alignment failure

functions.name: node_init
functions.role: OD/endpoint table + heartbeat buffer bring-up

functions.name: timer_arm
functions.role: Software timer arm: timer_arm(id<16, ms, cb) -> stores period/callback and sets the pending bit; returns -EINVAL if id>=16.

functions.name: heartbeat_publish
functions.role: publish 8-byte heartbeat OD frame, bump seq byte0, clear latched DTC masks

functions.name: led_ring_set_pixel
functions.role: Set one LED colour: asserts index<NUM_LEDS(10), writes packed 32-bit RGB to pixel[index] (off 0x48), sets dirty=2; -EINVAL if ring disabled.

functions.name: led_ring_flush
functions.role: Push current ring frame to the bus via can_send (3-byte control frame, fdf=0x6e); -EINVAL if disabled.

functions.name: led_ring_disable
functions.role: LED-ring disable: clears enabled/dirty word, logs 'led_ring_disable', snapshots status word to disable register.

functions.name: sys_image_open
functions.role: open a sys_image slot, fill descriptor {flags=8,cap=0x400,size,base} (vendor MCUboot)

functions.name: od_publish
functions.role: OD/CAN publish wrapper: emits payload only when descriptor transport state (desc[4]) == 2, else returns -EINVAL; forwards to FUN_00003028.

functions.name: od_send_buf
functions.role: low-level OD frame transmit helper used by heartbeat_publish

functions.name: vm_log
functions.role: takahe printf-style logger (variadic wrapper around format core FUN_000019c0; 'D>'/'E>' tagged format strings).

functions.name: vm_log
functions.role: printf-style logger (varargs trampoline -> 0x19c0); D>/E> severity-prefixed fmt strings

functions.name: can_set_init
functions.role: set/clear CCCR.INIT (bus-off recovery request)

functions.name: can_save_status
functions.role: stash last CAN error status words

functions.name: dtc_clear
functions.role: clear DTC bit(s); called with 0xff to clear all

functions.name: dtc_set
functions.role: OR DTC bit(s) into heartbeat high-status byte

functions.name: od_reply
functions.role: send an OD endpoint reply frame (trampoline into od_publish 0x3028)

functions.name: can_read_psr
functions.role: read CAN protocol-status register at node+PSR_OFF

functions.name: button_ctx
functions.role: Button context lookup: returns button_ctx_table[id] from the u32 pointer table at 0x20201f10.

functions.name: button_od_desc
functions.role: Button OD object descriptor {id=0x010008c0, fmt=2, len=3, period=100} published by button_fsm_tick.
